hook: Gary Wingrove took office as Global Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of KPMG International on October 1, 2026, for a four year term, succeeding Bill Thomas, who had led the network since 2017. He was nominated by KPMG's Global Board and elected by its Global Council in March 2026. As Global Chief Operating Officer before that, he helped shape and run KPMG's Collective Strategy, including the growth of the KPMG Delivery Network and the firm's digital and AI programmes. He says he means to bring agility, deep expertise and AI enabled solutions to the network's clients.
